reviewType: G0 per-request report contract and UTF-8 Draft validation

findings: Legacy evidence-only G0 PASS is rejected by both the Node consistency checker and Draft 2020-12 validation.
Node validation requires the per-request trace map to match the request ID set and rejects missing, extra, or mismatched request IDs.
Draft JSON Schema alone cannot express equality between the request ID array and arbitrary object keys; the Node checker enforces this relation, and explicit schema mode runs both validators.
UTF-8 stdin and ASCII-safe validator output preserve Unicode boundary checks and non-ASCII invalid-instance paths on Windows.

limitations: Synthetic report structures validate static contracts only; they are not runtime G0 observations or evidence.
The Draft 2020-12 validator uses the host Python jsonschema package and is not repository-pinned.
This work does not execute P01-P28 behavior, helper lifecycle, rollback, performance measurements, package validation, or target-visible paste.
